title: A Jedi to be
description: George Lucas hired veteran screenwriter Leigh Brackett to write a script for a sequel based on his original story treatment. Brackett finished the first draft on February 23, 1978, but passed away soon afterwards. Lucas disliked where she was taking the story, but without a writer to make adjustments, he was forced to pen the second draft himself, which he did throughout March. Major plot changes were made, and one of the most notable additions was the revelation that Darth Vader was Luke's father. This all-important piece of information was held back from licensees (including Topps!) preparing story-driven products based on the movie.
